bill.title: relative to health carrier recordkeeping requirements in utilization review, including specifications regarding the use of artificial intelligence.

posted_text:
🧠 NH HB1406 — NH Law Now Requires AI Tracking in Healthcare Decisions

New Hampshire is demanding that health carriers keep detailed records about how they use artificial intelligence in determining healthcare coverage. This includes documenting exactly which functions AI is used for and ensuring qualified healthcare professionals review key decisions made by the AI. Health carriers will also need to record if AI was used in adverse determinations, like payment denials, and provide clear explanations to patients. ...
